features.label: CMF server + FalkorDB
features.description: The memory server and its graph database. Always on.

features.label: LLM
features.description: Turns what you save, and the transcripts background capture reads, into memories. Providers in order of preference: the first is used; the rest are fallbacks on rate-limit or auth errors.

inputs.label: Providers, in order
inputs.replaces_note: Background capture now uses this list too; it was set separately to {{was}}. Unattended capture of one long session is dozens of calls on the first provider.

features.cost_note: Each memory written is a few LLM calls on the first provider; background capture of one long session is dozens. Put local first for $0.

features.label: Embeddings
features.description: Exactly one provider; vectors from different models can't be mixed in one graph.

features.label: Provider keys and local model URLs
features.description: Keys for the cloud providers you use, and the URL of an OpenAI-compatible local server (Ollama, LM Studio, a Spark box).

features.label: No knowledge base (memory only)
features.description: On when no knowledge source is. Turn the sources off to choose it.

features.label: Demo wiki (fictional demo data)
features.description: A small fictional wiki that ships with CMF, to try search on. Replace it with your own notes when you're ready.

features.label: Bring your own knowledge
features.description: On when your notes folder or Notion is on.

features.label: Notes folder (LLM Wiki, Obsidian, any Markdown)
features.description: CMF writes to it only when you approve a doc proposal.

features.label: Notion
features.description: Searches the pages shared with your Notion integration. Excerpts reach every connected AI app.

features.label: Google Drive
features.description: Search and cite the documents in your Google Drive as a knowledge source, read-only.

features.label: Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
features.description: Search and cite OneDrive and SharePoint documents as a knowledge source, read-only.

features.label: Background capture (transcript poller)
features.description: The poller reads every AI app's transcripts on this computer every 15 minutes, with the LLM list above, and queues what's worth keeping for review.
features.cost_note: Spends the first LLM provider on every captured session.

features.label: Messaging apps
features.description: Gmail (redesigned), Slack and Microsoft Teams: CMF reads the conversations you choose and queues what's worth keeping for review.

rules.message: Anthropic has no embeddings API; pick OpenAI, Gemini or a local model for embeddings.
Pick one knowledge option: memory only, the demo wiki, or your own sources.
The demo wiki and your notes folder both use LLM_WIKI_PATH; turn one off.
The graph already holds memories embedded with the current provider; changing it would mix vectors. Starting a new graph comes with a later step.
